reasoningEffortDescription: Controls the effort spent solving the task. Higher effort may require more time and tokens; available levels depend on the model.
reasoningSummaryDescription: Controls the detail of the summary provided in the thinking blocks. This is not raw internal reasoning, and a more detailed summary does not increase reasoning effort.
responseVerbosityDescription: Controls how concise or detailed the agent’s response text is. Does not hide commands, results or logs; their display is controlled by each agent’s Technical details setting.
